name: More Sparklematic Action
summary: Deep in Gnomeregan, the Sparklematic 5200 still cleans what can be saved. The machine remained behind when the city was evacuated, and for a small silver fee it scrubs curiosities coated in muck and radioactive sludge.

sections.title: Automated Restoration
sections.body: Gnomeregan's engineers installed automated devices throughout the city before the trogg invasion and the fallout that followed. Toxic waste and hostile automatons now fill its corridors, yet the Sparklematic 5200 still follows its exact programming. It needs three silver coins and an artifact caked in grime to begin.

sections.title: Wonders from the Muck
sections.body: The Sparklematic lurches as it sprays and scrubs an inserted relic with potent gnomish solvents. A cheerful chime marks the end of the cycle, and the machine dispenses a neatly packaged box. Inside is whatever salvage remained beneath corrosive trogg slime and toxic filth.

faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200 is an automated gnomish cleaning device inside Gnomeregan. It strips caustic sludge, grime, and radioactive residue from recovered objects, leaving salvage that can be identified.

faq.q: Why does the machine charge coins?
faq.answer: The Sparklematic needs three silver coins to begin a cleaning cycle. Its reason for charging is not explained.

faq.q: What kinds of objects can be put inside?
faq.answer: The machine cleans grime-encrusted objects, including relics recovered from fallen troggs, corrupted sentries, and irradiated horrors wandering Gnomeregan's tunnels.

faq.q: Is the Sparklematic safe from radiation?
faq.answer: Radioactive waste fills the exterior tunnels, but the Sparklematic 5200 still works. Its specialized gnomish cleaning agents scrub dangerous residue from incoming objects.

faq.q: Can both factions use the Sparklematic 5200?
faq.answer: Yes. The Sparklematic 5200 is a mechanical, automated installation that accepts payment and grime-encrusted items regardless of a visitor's allegiance.
The Sparklematic's creator is not named. The gnomish cleaning machine still works inside Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see the mechanical endurance of your people in the Sparklematic, still working amid the toxic ruins of your homeland.
As an engineer, you can study the device's sturdy gnomish solvent cycles and coin-activated mechanisms firsthand.
